The actions described in the paragraph likely violate legal standards regarding labor laws. Specifically, requiring employees to work beyond the maximum hours permitted by local labor laws is illegal, regardless of whether management claims it is a one-time exception. Labor laws typically set strict limits on working hours to protect employee health and safety, and these limits cannot be waived by employer discretion. Additionally, while extending hours without additional pay might be legal in some jurisdictions if the employees are salaried and exempt from overtime laws, the core violation here is the breach of the maximum hour limits.
